headline: Divided Fronts Stir as Base Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: The latest returns show the line shifting from scattered pressure to sharper contests in several sectors. FishermansRowHex remains the busiest field, rising to fifty-seven strategic-base events in twenty-four hours, with fourteen in the latest two; its ledger now reads six Colonial and three Warden holdings. FarranacCoastHex has emerged as a fresh trouble spot, recording fourteen daily events and three in the last two hours amid sharply accelerating casualty and enlistment rates. StlicanShelfHex has also quickened, posting five recent events and thirty-six for the day, while its divided holdings stand at five Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. LinnMercyHex has added three recent events to reach eighteen daily, with ten Colonial and one Warden base. WeatheredExpanseHex remains heavily contested at forty-two daily events, though no movement is recorded in the latest two hours; its split is five Warden to four Colonial. StonecradleHex retains a divided nine-base front after twelve daily events, including five in six hours, but none in the newest two-hour window. MooringCountyHex and CallahansPassageHex remain active in the broader ledger yet have quieted most recently.
